label: D2 after choosing a1 (strongest on switches to a1 and early in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and essentially only when the just-made choice was a1 (in_action == 1; 39649 of 39660 active steps). (phase==D2)&(action==1) has recall ~1.0 and mass recall ~1.0 but precision only 0.23, so a1 at D2 is the necessary condition, and other factors decide whether it crosses threshold. It is more likely to fire when the agent reached S1 (90% of mass; common a1 transitions), early in the episode (rate falls steadily from ~10% in trials 0-9 to ~0 in trials 90-99), after an unrewarded previous trial, and when the a1 choice is a switch from a2 (precision 0.71; the switch-to-a1 case holds most of the top-quartile activations, and the top examples are almost all first a1 after a run of a2). It never fires at D1 or GO, or after a2. The recorded predicate keeps a1-at-D2 and adds (reached S1 and ep_trial<50) or (switched to a1); dev F1 0.64, mass recall 0.90. Every variable in it is observed at D2 (the choice and stay are known once the choice is made). It is partially explained because precision stays around 0.5.
